name: Haute cuisine régionale
region: Vienne and Lyon, in the Rhône valley
summary: The restaurant of a master in a provincial town. Fernand Point at La Pyramide in Vienne cooks the classic sauce with the butter, cream and produce of his own region. A small kitchen, a short menu and a fine cellar draw guests to the road.

philosophy.core_thesis: Cook the classic dish well with the best produce of the region, on a short menu, and make the restaurant a place of travel.
design_principles: Buy the best local produce each day: Bresse chicken, crayfish, cream, butter and cheese.
Keep the classic sauce, and cook it with fresh butter and cream, with no short cut.
Keep the menu short and cook each dish to order, with a small team in the kitchen.
Serve each dish on a plate or a platter at the table, with the sauce beside it.
Train young cooks in the kitchen; each one learns each station.
Pair each dish with a wine of the Rhône valley, and let the cellar lead the meal.
Let the guest take time: a good meal takes a whole afternoon.
anti_patterns: A long menu of dishes made in advance
A grand pièce montée on the table
A heavy sauce that hides the produce
Produce from far away when a local one is as good
A cook who does not taste

plating.composition: One main piece at the centre of a large plate with a sauce beside it and one vegetable; the host or a waiter finishes the dish at the table.
plating.plate: A white porcelain plate of 260 to 280 mm, or a silver platter carried to the table on a trolley.
plating.portion: A main piece of 150 to 220 g with 60 to 90 ml of sauce and one garnish.
plating.height: The food stands 25 to 50 mm high, and the sauce pools 3 to 5 mm deep at its foot.
rules: Put the main piece at the centre and place the sauce beside it or under it.
Carve the Bresse chicken at the table and serve it at once.
Use a gratin dish for the crayfish and bring it to the table with the crust hot.
Keep the garnish to one vegetable or one mushroom.
Wipe the rim of each plate before it leaves the kitchen.

pantry.rule: Build on butter, cream and produce of the region, and add one luxury (truffle, foie gras or crayfish) to the dish of honour.

technique.bases: A veal stock, a chicken stock, a court-bouillon for fish and crayfish, a béchamel for the gratin and a butter sauce made to order.
technique.details: A gratin that browns under the heat, a chicken carved at the table, a butter sauce whisked at the last minute, a cake of nut layers cut in strips.

flavour.profile: Rich and clear: butter, cream and stock, with the sweet taste of crayfish, the scent of truffle and the lift of Rhône wine.
flavour.balance: Fat and umami lead; wine, lemon and a dry white wine lift the sauce; sweet stays in the dessert.
flavour.fat: Butter and cream give 45 to 60 per cent of the energy of a sauced main dish.
flavour.seasoning: Salt and white pepper, fines herbes at the end, and the cook tastes each sauce before it leaves.

palette.strategy: Use the white of the cloth and the plate, the gold of butter and gratin, and the red of crayfish, in warm light.

service.format: Service à la carte at a table in a provincial restaurant: the waiter brings each dish to the guest, and finishes it at the table.
service.courses: Four to six courses chosen from a short menu: a hors-d'oeuvre, a fish or shellfish dish, a poultry or meat dish, cheese and a dessert.
service.tableware: White porcelain, silver, crystal glasses for the wines of the Rhône valley and a white cloth.
service.setting: A roadside restaurant on the road to the south, with a small dining room, a big cellar and a kitchen of twelve cooks.

dishes.dish: Bresse chicken with cream and truffle
Poached salmon with a butter sauce
Roast Bresse chicken carved at the table
Marjolaine, a cake of almond and hazelnut layers

positive: chef in a tall white hat
overhead view of a plated dish

emotion.target_response: Warm trust and the calm of an afternoon: a master cook, a good local table and no hurry.

use_cases: a scene in a French provincial restaurant of the 1950s
a menu for a regional classic dinner
a food image of a butter and cream dish
avoid_when: the brief wants a light vegetable-led plate
the brief wants a modern tasting menu
the brief wants a grand hotel banquet

modifiers.request: lighter, with less flour and shorter cooking
modifiers.how: Drop the flour from the sauce, cook the fish and the vegetables for less time and plate each dish in the kitchen.

modifiers.request: more formal, with a brigade and a long menu
modifiers.how: Add a brigade of stations, a menu of nine courses and the classic garnishes.
